tasks.title: Add shared argv-to-arguments parser and usage generator

details.goal: One module in the shared kernel turns argv into the argument record a tool handler accepts, and prints a usage block generated from the tool's manifest literal, so the future `cgraph <tool>` command validates exactly what MCP validates.
steps: Create app/src/shared/cli/args.ts with the type declarations and move the four validator functions from app/src/index.ts unchanged.
Add the CliUsageError class carrying `usage`, and the parseCliArgs flag/positional scanner described in the contract.
Add usageOf generating the header line plus one line per declared field from `description`.

Create app/tests/cli-args.test.ts: for each of the seven manifests in app/src/tools/*/manifest.ts (import them directly in the test), assert parseCliArgs binds the required positional (query/target), and that defaults and unknown keys behave exactly as parseArgs does.
Add the failure cases: unknown flag, missing flag value, non-integer integer, second positional, and a bad enum value each throw CliUsageError whose `usage` respects usageOf.
Assert usageOf names every field of every manifest and marks the required one.
details.verify:
cd app && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/cli-args.test.ts && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun run typecheck
Done when: every test passes, tsc reports no error, and app/src/index.ts is unmodified (git diff --stat shows only the two owned files).

tasks.title: Add shared envelope renderer, status lines and exit-code mapping

details.goal: The CLI writes an envelope to stdout and derives its process exit code in one place, and `cgraph status` keeps printing exactly the four human lines it prints today.
steps: Create app/src/shared/cli/render.ts with the three functions and the two constants.
Implement statusLines by copying runStatus's formatting and replacing payload field access with guarded structural narrowing over `unknown`.
Create app/tests/cli-render.test.ts building envelopes with the existing helpers from #shared/envelope (ok/fail/bootstrapping/ambiguous/notFound).
Assert renderEnvelope output parses back with JSON.parse and has no newline except the trailing one, and that statusLines output equals the current runStatus wording for a realistic payload.
Assert exitCodeOf maps all five statuses, and that an envelope with a null payload does not throw and still prints the first line.
details.verify:
cd app && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/cli-render.test.ts && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun run typecheck
Done when: both commands pass and the four status lines match the current wording character for character (compare against app/src/index.ts runStatus).

tasks.title: Register the cgraph bin entry in package.json

details.goal: `bun link` inside app/ installs a `cgraph` command that runs app/bin/codegraph.ts, which already carries a `#!/usr/bin/env bun` shebang.
details.contract: Add `"bin": { "cgraph": "./bin/codegraph.ts" }` to app/package.json, as a top-level key next to `imports` and `scripts`. Keep `name`, `type`, `private`, `imports`, every script and every dependency exactly as they are; add no dependency and change no version. Do not run `bun link` or install anything globally — it is a documented user step, not part of this task.
steps: Read app/package.json and app/bin/codegraph.ts to confirm the shebang line exists.
Insert the `bin` block after `private` and before `imports`.
Confirm the file still parses and the scripts are unchanged.
details.verify:
cd app && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun -e 'const p=JSON.parse(await Bun.file("package.json").text()); console.log(p.bin.cgraph, Object.keys(p.scripts).length)'
Done when: it prints `./bin/codegraph.ts 10` (ten scripts), `git diff --stat` shows only app/package.json, and `head -1 bin/codegraph.ts` still prints the bun shebang.

details.goal: Prove phase_0 added two tested modules and one package field without changing any existing behaviour.
details.contract: Read-only verification. Do not edit source or tests. The phase's own files are app/src/shared/cli/args.ts, app/src/shared/cli/render.ts, app/tests/cli-args.test.ts, app/tests/cli-render.test.ts and app/package.json; anything else in the diff is a phase_0 defect to report, not to fix.
steps: Run the typecheck and lint scripts.
Run the two new test files, then the whole suite, to prove nothing existing moved.
Inspect `git status --short` and `git diff --stat` and report any file outside the phase_0 list.
Report the observed counts (tests passed/failed) and any warning worth a follow-up.
details.verify:
cd app && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun run typecheck && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun run lint && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test
Done when: typecheck and lint are clean, `bun test` is green, and the report lists no file outside phase_0's ownership.
